title: Pakala Narayana Swami v. King Emperor

content.caseIdentity: Pakala Narayana Swami v. King Emperor, AIR 1939 PC 47
content.holding: A confession must either admit the offence or substantially all the facts which constitute the offence. An admission of an incriminating circumstance is not automatically a confession.
content.relevance: Still the teaching definition. Apply it to BSA, do not treat it as a BSA section.
